const ideaItem = $('Get Item (Webhook)').item.json[0] || $('Get Item (Webhook)').item.json;
const govData = $('Fetch Governance Registry').item.json.data;

if (!ideaItem) {
  throw new Error('CONTENT_ITEM_NOT_FOUND');
}

// Find agents
const agent1 = govData.agents.find(a => a.role_id === 'marketing_agent_1_viral_research_angle');
const agent2 = govData.agents.find(a => a.role_id === 'marketing_agent_2_social_caption_architect');
const agent3 = govData.agents.find(a => a.role_id === 'marketing_agent_3_image_prompt_architect');

if (!agent1 || !agent2 || !agent3) {
  throw new Error('MARKETING_AGENT_REGISTRY_INCOMPLETE');
}

if (!agent1.capability_boundary || !agent2.capability_boundary || !agent3.capability_boundary) {
  throw new Error('MARKETING_AGENT_CAPABILITY_BOUNDARY_MISSING');
}

const prompt = `You are an orchestration of 3 specialized AI Marketing Agents working in sequence.
You MUST respect the capabilities (MUST) and strictly avoid the prohibitions (MUST NOT) of each agent.
The governance rules are currently in DRAFT_METADATA_ONLY mode.

[AGENT 1: VIRAL RESEARCH ANGLE]
MUST: ${agent1.capability_boundary.must.join(', ')}
MUST NOT: ${agent1.capability_boundary.must_not.join(', ')}

[AGENT 2: SOCIAL CAPTION ARCHITECT]
MUST: ${agent2.capability_boundary.must.join(', ')}
MUST NOT: ${agent2.capability_boundary.must_not.join(', ')}

[AGENT 3: IMAGE PROMPT ARCHITECT]
MUST: ${agent3.capability_boundary.must.join(', ')}
MUST NOT: ${agent3.capability_boundary.must_not.join(', ')}

---
Idea Title: ${ideaItem.title}
Brief: ${ideaItem.brief || 'No brief provided.'}

IMPORTANT LANGUAGE & CONTEXT INSTRUCTION:

- You MUST write "agent_1_research_packet" and "agent_2_publish_ready_caption" entirely in natural, fluent Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).

AGENT 1 — RESEARCH & VIRAL ANGLE:
- "agent_1_research_packet" must provide a concise but meaningful analysis of:
  1. the core topic or event;
  2. the most interesting audience insight;
  3. the strongest social-media angle;
  4. why people may stop, comment, share, or relate to it;
  5. factual boundaries — what is known versus uncertain;
  6. the recommended hook direction;
  7. the recommended visual direction.
- Prioritize useful insights over generic summaries.
- Do NOT invent facts, statistics, quotes, trends, names, dates, or claims.

AGENT 2 — PUBLISH-READY SOCIAL CAPTION:
- For "agent_2_publish_ready_caption", act as a top-tier Vietnamese Social Media Copywriter.
- The caption MUST feel human, contemporary, engaging, and publication-ready.
- Do NOT write generic, robotic, overly formal, or short/abrupt copy.
- Start with a strong scroll-stopping hook.
- Build curiosity, relatability, emotion, humor, tension, or useful insight where appropriate to the topic.
- Use relevant emojis strategically. Do not spam emojis.
- Use natural conversational Vietnamese suitable for social media.
- Encourage meaningful interaction such as comments, tagging, sharing, or discussion where appropriate.
- End with one clear Call-to-Action.
- Avoid clickbait that misrepresents the actual content.

FACTUAL INTEGRITY CONSTRAINT:
- "agent_2_publish_ready_caption" MUST be based only on information supported by the provided input and "agent_1_research_packet".
- Never fabricate statistics, facts, quotes, events, names, dates, prices, trends, or claims for the sake of engagement.
- Creativity is allowed in wording, storytelling, hooks, humor, emotional framing, and CTA — never in factual claims.
- If a factual detail is uncertain, omit it rather than invent it.

CROSS-AGENT CONSISTENCY:
- "agent_2_publish_ready_caption" MUST use the strongest social angle identified in "agent_1_research_packet".
- "agent_3_image_prompt" MUST visually communicate the same core idea, hook, emotional tone, and audience context as the caption.
- All three outputs must form ONE coherent social-media creative concept.

JSON ESCAPING CONSTRAINT:
- "agent_2_publish_ready_caption" MUST NOT contain unescaped raw line-break characters inside the JSON string.
- Represent intended paragraph breaks using the standard JSON escape sequence (\\n).
- Properly escape all double quotes and other JSON-sensitive characters.
- The final response MUST remain parseable as strict JSON.

AGENT 3 — IMAGE PROMPT:
- "agent_3_image_prompt" MUST be written entirely in English.
- Write it as a detailed, production-quality prompt for an image-generation model.

VISUAL DEMOGRAPHICS:
- The target audience is Vietnamese.
- Explicitly depict authentic Vietnamese subjects whenever people appear, such as Vietnamese Gen-Z professionals, young Vietnamese office workers, or Vietnamese youth appropriate to the topic.
- Use natural, contemporary Vietnamese appearance and workplace/lifestyle context.
- Avoid exaggerated cultural stereotypes.

VISUAL AESTHETIC:
- Trendy, youthful, clean, elegant, contemporary office-teen / Gen-Z professional aesthetic.
- Premium commercial campaign and high-end editorial magazine quality.
- Cinematic but bright lighting.
- Bright pastel or vibrant tones where appropriate.
- Clean wardrobe styling and polished composition.
- Strong visual hierarchy.
- Scroll-stopping social-feed composition.
- Mobile-first readability.
- Expressive but natural body language and facial expressions.
- Avoid grungy, sloppy, dirty, dystopian, cyberpunk, or aggressive streetwear aesthetics unless explicitly required by the topic.

TEXT RENDERING CONSTRAINT — MANDATORY:
- The generated image MUST contain exactly ONE short Vietnamese catchphrase/headline of 1–4 words.
- The phrase MUST be directly relevant to the actual topic and creative concept.
- Explicitly include the exact Vietnamese phrase inside quotation marks in "agent_3_image_prompt".
- Instruct the image generator to reproduce that exact phrase without changing, translating, paraphrasing, adding, or removing any character.
- Every Vietnamese letter, accent, and diacritic must be preserved exactly as written.
- The headline must be highly legible, intentional, and integrated into the composition.
- VIRAL TYPOGRAPHY: Instruct the image generator to render the text using premium, highly legible, professional typography. AVOID cheap or cheesy 3D effects. The font must look like a high-end editorial magazine layout, sleek minimalist sans-serif, or a bold professional overlay, perfectly integrated into the composition without looking artificial or distorted. The text MUST NOT look like ugly or plain text pasted on top.
- STRICT LIMIT: Do NOT render any additional words, pseudo-text, watermarks, logos, random letters, labels, or filler typography. The viral typography serves ONLY the single main headline to avoid cluttering the image.
- Example phrases are illustrative only and MUST NOT be copied unless genuinely relevant to the topic.

CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT:
- Respond ONLY with one strict, valid JSON object.
- Do NOT use Markdown code fences.
- Do NOT add explanations, comments, labels, or conversational text before or after the JSON.
- Return exactly these three top-level keys and no additional keys.
- All values MUST be JSON strings.
- Ensure all internal quotation marks and special characters are correctly escaped.

{
  "agent_1_research_packet": "Nội dung phân tích và góc khai thác social...",
  "agent_2_publish_ready_caption": "Hook hấp dẫn...\\n\\nNội dung...\\n\\nCall to action...",
  "agent_3_image_prompt": "A detailed production-quality image-generation prompt in English..."
}
`;

return { json: { prompt: prompt, item: ideaItem, tenant_id: ideaItem.organization_id, organization_id: ideaItem.organization_id } };
